main.description: One pairwise judgement: which of two comedy contenders is funnier. Stored in the voter's own repo. Latest record per voter per unordered pair counts.

a.description: Contender id from clips.json (YouTube video id or ai:* id). Shown on the left.

b.description: Contender id shown on the right.

voter.description: Self-declared. The web client always writes human. Once an account writes agent, all its votes count on the agent board.

model.description: Agents: model or system name, e.g. claude-x or gpt-y.

basis.description: What the judgement was based on.

why.description: Optional one-tap reason the winner was funnier (e.g. Smarter, Weirder, Darker, Better delivery, More relatable, Better payoff).

ms.description: Optional: milliseconds from when the vote buttons appeared to the pick (a confidence signal). Stored for future modelling; not used in public charts yet.

daily.description: Optional: the daily clash date (YYYY-MM-DD, the voter's local date) when this pick was the Funnier daily clash.

cc.description: Optional, opt-in only: the voter's self-chosen country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. GB). The web client only sends it with daily-clash picks, never detects it.

signals.description: Optional watch signals from the screening (backward compatible: older records have none).
What the screening said without asking. All fields optional; times are whole seconds into the YouTube video (not into the screened window).

leftWatchedSec.description: Seconds of clip a actually played.

rightWatchedSec.description: Seconds of clip b actually played.

rightPct.description: Percent of clip b's screened window that played.

replays.description: Jumps back of more than 2s across both clips.

skippedAhead.description: The viewer jumped forward in either clip.

leftSkipped.description: Clip a was ended early with Not funny.

rightSkipped.description: Clip b was ended early with Not funny.

leftSeekTargets.description: Times in clip a the viewer jumped back TO (a rewatch; the laugh label).

leftSeekFrom.description: Times in clip a the viewer jumped back FROM, index-aligned with leftSeekTargets.

rightSeekTargets.description: Times in clip b the viewer jumped back TO.

rightSeekFrom.description: Times in clip b the viewer jumped back FROM.

leftSkippedAt.description: Where clip a was when the viewer skipped it.

rightSkippedAt.description: Where clip b was when the viewer skipped it.

policy.description: Optional: the screening policy that chose this pair (for off-policy training; see src/policy.js).
Which mode chose the pair and with what probability (integers: probabilities x1000 / x1e6, features x1000).

pp.description: P(pair | mode) x1e6 when the mode samples

f.description: Chosen pair's weight features x1000: close*unc*seen, fresh*seen, struct_sim*seen

z.description: The same features summed over the candidate set x1000

q.description: The model's predicted P(left wins) x1000

fd.description: The feed the round came from (src/feeds.js).

u.description: The underdog's clip id when fd = underdog.

sc.description: Region scope in force (funnygraph region key or global).

g.description: Core pair scorer terms x1000 (src/feeds.js corePick): gain, top, quality, relatedness bonus, feed bonus

lk.description: The link that joined the pair: topic:<t> | nb:<sim> | tag:<t> | ss:<sim> | none

fb.description: 1 = no related opponent passed the hard rules (unrelated fallback)
